mine: shall become forced laborers for you
note: Hebrew mas denotes corvée, forced labour (as under Solomon, 1 Kgs 9:21), not the payment of tribute.

kjv: (for the tree of the field [is] man's [life]) to employ [them] in the siege
mine: Is the tree of the field a human being, that it should be besieged by you?
note: Hebrew ki ha'adam 'ets hassadeh lavo' mippaneykha bammatsor is terse; most modern readers take it (with the Septuagint) as a rhetorical question, "is the tree a man, to come into siege before you?", whereas the KJV, following the Masoretic pointing as a statement, supplies "life" and "employ them" to make the trees man's sustenance.
